producer_report.summary: Wrote docs/design/hestia.md, a design for Hestia as a rules-first sweep with Hades's cleanup as a "retire" check group. Added D129 (proposed) at the end of docs/decisions.md, a CHANGELOG bullet under Unreleased, and a two-line pointer in docs/design/roadmap.md. No code or governance files changed. The design has an eight-row table (check, code or model, cadence, fix or report), an empty-findings rule, a budget with a stop rule, measures, the Hades fold-in and split triggers, seven alternatives, the Artemis boundary, and a 10-job build plan with deterministic checks first. Every figure is labeled an estimate, and the request's figures are cited as stated. I ran only the decision tests and fmt, not the full suite.

checks_run.note: Decision-log guard and link tests pass with D129 appended.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/hestia.md has a section or table row for each of the eight items: queued requests done or superseded; leftover branches, worktrees and build caches (citing the 2026-10-23 disk-full cache); checkpoints never pushed; installed binary older than its source; prompt budgets nearly full; the unevaluated keep rule; athena propose never run; docs that no longer match the code. Each row states the check, whether it is deterministic code or needs a model, its cadence, and whether Hestia fixes it as a small job or reports a work item.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 2 of docs/design/hestia.md has a table of 8 rows with Check, Code or model, Cadence and Fix or report columns. Row 2 cites the 2026-10-23 cache. I wrote and re-read it.

criteria_check.criterion: The design states Hestia's budget (dollars and wall time per run, in total, with a stop rule) and how findings are measured (for example findings per run, true-positive rate on spot check, time from appearance to resolution). It labels every number as an estimate or says where it was measured. It also says how Hades's cleanup is folded in and when it would split out.
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 4 (budget and stop rule, all estimates), 5 (measures) and 6 (fold-in and two split triggers) of docs/design/hestia.md.

criteria_check.criterion: The design lists alternatives (for example: model-only sweeps, separate Hades now, folding into the scope guard of D127) and states the boundary with Artemis (D127 says Hestia does not gate work), with sources cited from BRIEF.md and the repository.
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 7 (seven alternatives) and 8 (Artemis and Demeter boundary) of docs/design/hestia.md cite BRIEF.md lines 603, 604, 606, 607 and 1058-1061, D127 and scope-guard.md. I read the BRIEF.md lines to confirm them.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md gains one new entry, numbered after D128, with status proposed (not accepted), in the same fields as neighbouring entries (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance), inserted as a top-level entry and not inside another.
criteria_check.evidence: D129 is a top-level `##` heading appended after D128, with Status proposed and all six fields. cargo test -p athena-cli decision passed.

criteria_check.criterion: The design has a build plan of numbered jobs, each sized for one producer run, with deliverables, a test or behavior check, and dependencies, with the deterministic checks first.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 9 of docs/design/hestia.md has Jobs 1 to 10, each with Deliverables, Check and Depends on. Jobs 2 to 6 are the deterministic ones and the model checks come at jobs 7 and 8.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the design and the proposed decision, matching the file's existing format. No code, athena.toml or defaults.toml file changes.
criteria_check.evidence: One bullet added under [Unreleased] / Changed in the existing style. The changed files are two docs, the design, CHANGELOG.md and roadmap.md. No .rs, athena.toml or defaults.toml file changed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test` and `cargo fmt --check` from the repository root; both pass, which shows that existing doc-linking or decision-numbering tests accept the new entry and design file.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full cargo test. I ran `cargo fmt --all --check` (pass) and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli decision --quiet` (pass).

open_issues: The full cargo test suite was not run by me, so the boundary-word scan and the budgets test are unchecked beyond Athena's own run.
docs/decision-links.toml was left unchanged because D129 avoids the supersession and amend phrases; the decision tests passed.
The sweep trigger (drain hook, timer or command) is not settled from the code and is deferred to build job 1.
The request's figures (49 open requests, the disk fill, stale binary, unpushed checkpoints) could not be checked because records/ is absent.
mistakes: A first CHANGELOG edit failed because the match was not unique; I fixed it by including the Unreleased heading.
learnings: The decision log is append-only and hash-pinned, so a new decision goes at the very end of docs/decisions.md.
CHANGELOG.md has many `### Changed` headings, so an edit needs the `## [Unreleased]` line as context to be unique.
The Bash tool rejects `git grep`; Grep cannot read paths outside the working directory.
desires: A way to read a saved tool-output file inside the working directory, to check full test results.
